reason: The native 128x128 output preserved the scaffold footprint perfectly but collapsed all 3416 opaque pixels to a single RGB value, so it produced a monochrome silhouette rather than authored Exilada pixel art.
architectural_lesson: PixelLock's GBNF footprint lock is valuable only after a good sprite footprint already exists. In the tested 2x mode it cannot invent or repair the source silhouette; using it as the initial Exilada source generator is structurally the wrong role.
decision: Do not tune PixelLock prompts, temperature, palette, seed, or upscale parameters for G3S-A. Preserve it only as a possible later footprint-safe recolor/restyle utility after canonical pixel assets exist.
